# README artwork

## Current cover

- [cover-imagegen.webp](cover-imagegen.webp): the active README header, generated
  with the built-in imagegen tool. Source PNGs are kept in the maintainer workspace.
- [Prompt and reference notes](cover-imagegen.prompt.md): generation and revision
  instructions, with public reference links where available.

The header is an AI-generated conceptual illustration. Hardware drawings, screens,
handwritten notes and decorative plots in the artwork are illustrative; they are
not experimental evidence. Refer to the repository demos and reports for results.
The original SVG cover is retained as an archived editable design.

## Vector artwork


Original, editable SVG illustrations created for this repository.
No stock images, external fonts, embedded scripts or external image references
are included. The cover is a conceptual illustration, not a hardware drawing,
product screenshot or experimental result.

- `cover.svg`: archived vector cover (1440 × 440).

- `workflow.svg` and `workflow-mobile.svg`: conceptual reading and project maps;
  not an automatic pipeline or a claim of successful execution.

Edit the SVG text and shapes directly. Keep the project name, method labels
and README alt text consistent with the actual repository contents.
Use the existing repository license where one is provided; this visual update
does not assign a license to previously unlicensed project material.
